name: Reversal
description: You unleash an all out attack that is stronger the less HP you have. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing 1d6 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. If you are below 50% of your maximum health, double the damage. If you are at 10% or below of your maximum health, triple the damage instead. The multiplier for this attack occurs before the multiplier for resistances or vulnerabilities.
higherLevels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d12 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.
